style.vernacular: Dense tropical metropolis: narrow deep "nha ong" tube houses 3-6 storeys tall in rendered pastel and ochre with balconies, roller shutters and tiled or flat roofs with water tanks; a core of yellow-and-white French colonial civic buildings with shutters and red tile roofs; concrete towers with glass curtain walls; Buddhist pagodas with upswept red-tile roofs; large old rain trees and tamarinds lining streets, scooters everywhere.
style.ornament: French colonial yellow render with white moulded trim, louvred green or brown shutters and arched verandas; Vietnamese pagoda roofs with upturned eaves, dragon and phoenix ridge figures and red columns; tube-house frontages with wrought-iron balcony grilles and tiled lower facades; ceramic mosaic dragons.
